# Roadmap: the shop that changes itself

<!-- Generated by scripts/roadmap.py from docs/roadmap.json. Edit the JSON, then run the script. -->

**The shop that changes itself and demonstrably breaks nothing.** Every stage below reuses the existing core,
private sandboxes and review. A stage counts as working only when it has a
guide and a dated record of what was observed. The [status page](status.md)
stays the record of what is deployed.

| # | Stage | State | What it does | Builds on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Test customers that attack](customer-scenarios.md#attack-test)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/stages-1-3-completion-2026-11-18.md)) | Before a change goes live, scripted attackers try forged totals, stale carts, impossible quantities and replayed orders against the private copy. The result is saved and shown beside the release review. | Customer simulator, private sandboxes, native cart and checkout operations |
| 2 | **[A twin of your existing shop](shop-twin.md)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/stages-1-3-completion-2026-11-18.md)) | Bring a catalog from Shopware, Shopify, WooCommerce or CSV into a private copy, set test stock with one click and let test customers and attackers try it. Nobody has to migrate first. | Migration Assistant, catalog import, customer simulator |
| 3 | **[Autopilot levels with a daily limit](knowledge-workspace.md#autopilot-levels-and-the-daily-limit)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/stages-1-3-completion-2026-11-18.md)) | See per area whether an agent suggests or acts. For prices it may act within a budget with a daily limit for price reductions. You can take changes back, and the autopilot takes them back by itself when the limit is exceeded. | Existing price autonomy with daily product budget, price corridors, agent credentials with allowances |
| 4 | **[Experiments that run themselves](knowledge-workspace.md#experiments-that-run-themselves)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/self-running-experiments-2026-11-18.md)) | Get an experiment suggested from your shop's own payments, start it once, and it finishes, reads out and decides by itself. A proved layout can be adopted automatically; without proof the shop stays as it is. | Preregistered layout experiments with consent-bound assignment and payment-ledger readout |
| 5 | **[Signed offers for buying agents](agentic-commerce.md#signed-offers)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/signed-offers-2026-11-18.md)) | A buying agent receives the cart's quote with a signature it can check offline with the shop's public key. Checkout confirms exactly that cart version and total, or refuses. It is not a price lock. | Binding quotes over HTTP, MCP and UCP; short-lived signed native facts |
| 6 | **[Reorder between shops](trade-network.md)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/trade-network-2026-11-18.md)) | Link a product to the shop you buy it from. At the reorder point your shop fetches a signed offer from that shop, checks it against your ceiling and hands over to the supplier's checkout after your approval. Same installation only, nothing is ordered by itself. | Signed offers, checkout handoff, public cart operations of the supplier shop |
| 7 | **[Proof coverage you can read](proof-coverage.md)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/proof-coverage-2026-11-18.md)) | A generated page lists every machine-proved rule with its properties and callers, the share of unproved source files and the state of the money path. It is rebuilt from the proof manifest and checked on every change. | 63 extracted Lean policies, proof manifest, differential checks against original PHP |
| 8 | **[Sovereign AI mode](sovereign-ai.md)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/sovereign-ai-2026-11-18.md)) | One switch keeps every model request on models you host yourself. Studio shows the host of each model route. | Local model route, central provider settings, per-task model routing |

## How this page stays current

The stages live in one file, [`docs/roadmap.json`](roadmap.json), in English,
German, French and Spanish. `python3 scripts/roadmap.py` writes this page,
the roadmap line in the README and the data module the website reads.
The required quick check runs `python3 scripts/roadmap.py --check` and fails
when any of them differs from the file, or when a stage claims to work
without a guide and a dated record.
